description: Does this manual or procedure apply to this unit? — Checks whether a manual, service bulletin or procedure applies to a specific unit by comparing the scope the document declares (models, firmware or revision range, serial range, exclusions) with the unit's facts the caller supplies. Versions written as dotted digits (2.10.1) compare numerically per segment. For an agent about to follow a repair or configuration procedure. Applicable only when ever

applicability.description: Scope the document declares: every entry must match.

equals.description: The evidence value must equal this JSON value (deep equality).

field.description: Unit attribute, for example model, firmware, serial, revision.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, same comparison rules as min.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Numbers compare numerically; two dotted-digit strings (1.10.2) compare segment by segment.

oneOf.description: The evidence value must equal one of these.

excludes.description: Scope the document excludes: each entry that matches makes it inapplicable.

equals.description: The evidence value must equal this JSON value (deep equality).

field.description: Unit attribute, for example model, firmware, serial, revision.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, same comparison rules as min.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Numbers compare numerically; two dotted-digit strings (1.10.2) compare segment by segment.

oneOf.description: The evidence value must equal one of these.

unit.description: The unit's facts: key is the field name.

asOf.description: When this was observed (ISO date or instant).

value.description: Observed JSON value. Omitted means the fact is present with no value; false or null means observed absent.

name: manual-applicability
